body.name: Z
body.def: \(Z=(Z_1,\ldots,Z_K)\), where \(Z_k=\operatorname{adj}_{M_k(\eta)}(\zeta_k)\cap V\), is read from the full signature \(\mathcal O\). By Dai et al.'s Lemma 5, \(Z_k=T_k(\eta)\cup((F_k(\eta)\setminus T_k(\eta))\cap A(\eta))\); hence \(Z_k\) contains direct targets together with any indirectly affected ancestrally selected variables and need not equal \(T_k(\eta)\).
